name: $100M Offers
tagline: Turns what you sell into an offer people actually want, in plain English
description: Describe what you sell and who you sell it to, and it works the offer until the value is obvious: what is included, what makes it different, and why the price feels fair. The framing follows Alex Hormozi's book on offer design, explained in plain language for people new to marketing rather than for agencies.
